source: RE benchmark problems (Tanabe & Ishibuchi, 2020). 16 unconstrained multi-objective problems where original constraints are reformulated as penalty objectives. Sign convention --------------- The RE problems are defined for **minimization**. BoCoDe **maximizes**, so every ``_evaluate_implementation`` here returns ``-fx`` (the negated original objectives) and ``ref_point`` is the negated published reference point.
